about: The two python.org files the 0.9-beta user package is built from (tools/build_package.py; backlog, item 19 (d)): the 64-bit embeddable Python 3.13.16, and the full 64-bit package of the same version, of which only tkinter and Tcl/Tk are taken. SHA-256 as python.org states it in windows-3.13.16.json. Used with: python tools/fetch.py --manifest tools/manifest_package.json --to <folder outside the project>
licence_notes: Checked 2026-10-24 (packaging session 2) against the licence texts inside these two files: LICENSE.txt (PSF License Version 2; Microsoft Distributable Code terms for vcruntime140*.dll; bzip2, libffi (MIT), OpenSSL 3 (Apache 2.0), Tcl and Tk (BSD-style)), tcl/tk8.6/license.terms, and Doc/html/license.html (expat, zlib, libmpdec, mimalloc and the other incorporated code). SQLite is public domain; liblzma public domain or 0BSD. All permissive - compatible with shipping them beside the MIT-licensed app; the package carries LICENSE.txt, license.terms and THIRD-PARTY-NOTICES.txt (tools/build_package.py).
